units.source_text: 《心地观经》云：“若善男子善女人发阿耨多罗三藐三菩提心，一日一夜出家修道，二百万劫不堕恶趣。”

en.t: The Sutra on Contemplating the Mind-Ground says: “If good men and good women awaken the aspiration for unsurpassed perfect enlightenment, leave home for one day and one night, and practice the Way, they will not fall into the evil realms for two million kalpas.”
